cases.translation: The vision of the prophet Obadiah.
cases.explain: The preposition к (to) governs the dative case, indicating direction toward.

cases.sentence: Вот я сделаю тебя, Эдом, малым среди ___.
cases.translation: Behold, I have made you small among the nations.
cases.explain: The preposition среди (among) governs the genitive case.

cases.translation: The pride of your heart has deceived you.
cases.explain: The verb обольстила (deceived) is transitive and takes the accusative case for its direct object.

cases.translation: Who will bring me down to the ground?
cases.explain: The preposition на with the accusative indicates movement toward or placement on a location.

cases.sentence: Но даже если ты поднимешься высоко, как орел, и устроишь гнездо среди ___, я низвергну тебя.
cases.translation: Though you mount high as the eagle and set your nest among the stars, I will bring you down.
cases.explain: The preposition среди (among) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Как все будет обыскано у Исава, будут ограблены его ___.
cases.translation: How Esau will be ransacked! How his hidden treasures are sought out!
cases.explain: The hidden treasures are the subject being robbed, standing in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Ты стоял в стороне в тот день, когда уносили его ___.
cases.translation: You stood on the other side in the day that strangers carried away his substance.
cases.explain: The verb уносили (carried away) is transitive; the noun богатство (a neuter noun) in accusative singular has the same form as nominative.

cases.sentence: Спасители взойдут на гору Сион, чтобы править горою ___.
cases.translation: Saviors will go up on Mount Zion to judge the mountains of Esau.
cases.explain: The noun phrase 'mountains of Esau' uses the genitive Исава to show possession.

reading.ru: Вот я сделаю тебя, Эдом, малым среди народов.
reading.question: What does the Lord say He will do to Edom?
options: Make it small among the nations
reading.correct: Make it small among the nations
reading.explain: The Lord says to Edom: 'Behold, I have made you small among the nations.'

reading.question: What will be the fate of Edom according to this prophecy?
reading.explain: The text states: 'You are greatly despised,' indicating great shame and contempt.

reading.question: What has deceived Edom according to this passage?
reading.explain: The text says: 'The pride of your heart has deceived you.'

reading.ru: В тот день, — возвещает Господь, — я истреблю мудрых во доме и благоразумных на горе Исава.
reading.question: What will the Lord destroy in Edom on that day?
options: The wise men and the men of understanding
reading.correct: The wise men and the men of understanding
reading.explain: The Lord says: 'Won't I in that day destroy the wise men out of Edom, and understanding out of the mountain of Esau?'

reading.ru: Ты стоял в стороне в тот день, когда чужие народы уносили его богатство.
reading.question: What was Edom's response when strangers took Israel's wealth?
options: They stood on the other side and did nothing
reading.correct: They stood on the other side and did nothing
reading.explain: The text says: 'In the day that you stood on the other side, in the day that strangers carried away his substance.'

reading.ru: Спасители взойдут на гору Сион, чтобы править горою Исава, и наступит царствование Господа.
reading.question: What does the prophecy say will happen at the end?
options: Saviors will judge Esau and the kingdom will be the Lord's
The nations will rise against God
reading.correct: Saviors will judge Esau and the kingdom will be the Lord's
reading.explain: The text says: 'Saviors will go up on Mount Zion to judge the mountains of Esau, and the kingdom will be Yahweh's.'
